# CLI reference

```text
ContractGuard — detect breaking changes between versions of an OpenAPI contract

Usage: contractguard <command> [options]

Commands:
  check             Compare specifications and apply the compatibility policy
  validate          Load, parse, resolve and validate specifications
  explain           Show rule documentation from the catalog
  baseline create   Bundle a specification into a snapshot for later comparison (snapshot:<file>)
  init              Write a commented .contractguard.yaml for this repository

Global options:
  -h, --help                        Show help
  -q, --quiet                       Only print errors and machine output
  -v, --verbose                     Print more detail (all findings, warnings)
      --debug                       Print stack traces for internal errors
      --color                       Force coloured output
      --no-color                    Disable coloured output (also NO_COLOR)
      --version                     Print the version

Exit codes: 0 passed · 1 policy failed · 2 invalid input · 3 usage/config error · 4 internal error · 130 interrupted
Run "contractguard <command> --help" for command options.
```

## check

```text
Compare specifications and apply the compatibility policy

Usage: contractguard check [base] [candidate] [options]

Options:
  -c, --config <file>               Configuration file (default: discover .contractguard.yaml)
      --no-config                   Do not read a configuration file
      --base-ref <ref>              Revision used for git:@base:<path> sources (e.g. origin/main)
      --spec <id>                   Only run the configured spec with this id (repeatable)
  -p, --perspective <id>            Compatibility perspective (provider-backward)
  -f, --format <list>               Report formats: console,markdown,json,sarif
  -o, --output-dir <dir>            Directory for report files (default .contractguard/reports)
      --stdout <format>             Print one machine format (json, sarif, markdown) to stdout
      --fail-on <list>              Classifications that fail the policy (default breaking)
      --min-severity <sev>          Findings below this severity never fail the policy
      --undetermined <mode>         fail | review | ignore (default review)
      --no-fail                     Exit 0 after a completed analysis even if the policy fails
      --ci                          CI mode (default when CI=true): no colour, writes files, trust rules
      --allow-remote-references     Trust references.allowRemote from the config in CI mode
      --allow-invalid-spec          Continue past specification errors (run marked degraded)
      --group-by <cause|operation>  Grouping for console and Markdown
      --include-equivalent          Report equivalent representation changes
      --sarif-all                   Include non-breaking and informational findings in SARIF
      --deterministic               Omit timestamps (byte-stable reports)
  -h, --help                        Show help
  -q, --quiet                       Only print errors and machine output
  -v, --verbose                     Print more detail (all findings, warnings)
      --debug                       Print stack traces for internal errors
      --color                       Force coloured output
      --no-color                    Disable coloured output (also NO_COLOR)
```

## Sources

| Form | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `openapi.yaml` | A file in the working tree |
| `git:<ref>:<path>` | The file at a git revision, e.g. `git:origin/main:api/openapi.yaml`. Relative `$ref`s resolve in the same commit. The path is relative to the current directory. |
| `git:@base:<path>` | The file at the base revision: the GitHub Action's base commit, or `--base-ref` |
| `snapshot:<file>` | A snapshot written by `contractguard baseline create` (checksummed) |
| `https://…` | A remote document; only when allowed (`references.allowRemote`) |
| `-` | Standard input (candidate only, self-contained) |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Analysis completed and the policy passed (or `--no-fail`) |
| 1 | Analysis completed and the policy failed |
| 2 | Invalid input: a specification could not be loaded, parsed or validated |
| 3 | Usage or configuration error |
| 4 | Internal error (please report it) |
| 130 | Interrupted (Ctrl+C) |

## Environment variables

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `CI=true` | CI mode: no colour, JSON report files, trust rules for remote references |
| `NO_COLOR` / `FORCE_COLOR` | Disable / force coloured output |
| `CONTRACTGUARD_CONFIG` | Configuration file to use |
| `CONTRACTGUARD_LOG_LEVEL` | `quiet`, `verbose` or `debug` |
